category.description: operation = a campaign; infrastructure = standing capability (site networks, persona farms); incident = a single documented event; takedown = platform/vendor disruption report; measurement = studies quantifying the phenomenon; context = needed for honest framing but not itself an AI-enabled op

sponsor.description: state or entity assessed to be behind the actor; 'domestic' | 'unattributed' allowed

confidence.description: confirmed = platform/vendor takedown or court/government record; high = multiple independent credible attributions; medium = single credible attribution; contested = disputed; unattributed = origin unknown

ai_usage.description: specific documented AI uses (e.g. 'LLM-rewritten articles', 'deepfake audio', 'AI news-anchor avatars', 'LLM grooming'); empty array = no documented AI component (context entries)

scale.description: quantified reach/volume with a source for each figure

effectiveness.description: what the evidence says about measured impact — be honest, including nulls

data_refs.description: paths under data/derived/ backing any numbers used

caveats.description: attribution disputes, unverified elements, overclaim risks

status.description: draft until every source has been re-checked against the claim
